description:
This release adds NAT hole punching for clients and improves the file browse view.

Both servers and clients need to update to take advantage of NAT hole punching. To learn more about it, visit https://friendnet.org/news/nat-hole-punching/.
As usual, servers and clients are backwards- and forwards-compatible, so all existing features will continue to work regardless of whether servers or clients update.

Changes:
 - Added NAT hole punching for peer direct connections.
 - Added file size column to files table
 - Added pagination for large folders
